title: Why Christmas Makes You Broke Until March
alts: The Hidden Reason You're Still Paying Off Last Christmas
Why Your Credit Card Never Recovers From December
line1: Why are you still paying off Christmas in March? Dave finds $312 of leftover holiday debt — and it's not bad luck, it's the business model.
summary: Dave checks his banking app in March and finds he's still paying off last Christmas: a candle, a sweater nobody wears, and wrapping paper. We break down why that happens: the real average holiday spend (NRF), how about one in three Black Friday 'deals' aren't real discounts, why buy-now-pay-later hit an all-time high last holiday season, how credit card balances spike in Q4 and don't fully come back down, how toy marketing targets kids directly, and why 37% of shoppers carry real debt into January. Then a practical, November-first way to close out the year without a March surprise.
